rows.name: team-with-console
rows.summary: A team that reaches its operations through a console modelled as an architecture of its own, console, nested here as one part pinned by its digest. The owner prompts the console's steward, the one part on the console's border, as `console.steward`; the steward orders the workers and answers their questions, and asks the owner what it cannot decide. The simulator flattens the console into this document (its parts run as `console.steward`, `console.helper`, `console.gateway` and `console.model`) and simulates the result as any other architecture.

rows.name: console
rows.summary: A console as an architecture of its own, made to be nested in another one: a steward agent is the one part on its border, hands work to a helper agent, and both reach their model through a gateway. A document that nests it reaches the steward as `console.steward` and nothing else of it. On its own the console has no principal: it is checked and drawn here, and simulated inside the architecture that nests it, team-with-console.
